name: Dinner escaped
text: You spent hours tracking dinner. Dinner ran away. So, does your prehistoric camp go hungry? Not necessarily.

name: More than hunting
text: Hunting was only part of the food story. Depending on the place and season, people also gathered edible plants and caught smaller animals.

name: Learned knowledge
text: Knowing where to look mattered. So did knowing what not to eat.

name: Other work
text: Meanwhile, other people were gathering fuel, preparing food, and maintaining tools.

name: Shared work
text: Your failed hunt was one part of the day, not everyone's entire survival plan. Sharing work and resources helped people handle uncertainty.

name: The joke
text: Tonight's meal might be modest. But at least nobody asks why you didn't just order delivery.
